description_en: Checks whether a service-linked role (SLR) is created
description_zh: 该接口用于查看是否已创建服务关联角色（SLR）
kebab_example: aliyun rds check-service-linked-role --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --service-linked-role AliyunServiceRoleForRdsPgsqlOnEcs --resource-group-id rg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CheckServiceLinkedRole
